name: ホワイトバランス分析
description: 分析します color temperature consistency にわたる the image. AI images may show inconsistent ホワイトバランス or unnatural color cast パターン.
algorithm: Gray World + Color Temperature Consistency Analysis
mechanism: Estimates ホワイトバランス using gray world assumption and 分析する color temperature consistency にわたる image regions.
parameters: Method: gray world, Region 分析: block-based
source: Van de Weijer et al. (2007), IEEE TIP
useCase: Detecting ホワイトバランス 不整合 in AI images

references.title: Van de Weijer, J. et al. (2007). Edge-based Color Constancy. IEEE TIP.
Riess, C. & Angelopoulou, E. (2010). Scene Illumination as an Indicator of Image Manipulation. Information Hiding.
Gijsenij, A. et al. (2011). Computational Color Constancy: Survey and Experiments. IEEE TIP.

strengths:
• 検出します color temperature 不整合 にわたる regions
• Based on physics of 照明 and surface reflectance
• Effective for composite image 検出
• Multiple illuminant estimation algorithms available
• Reveals AI color cast アーティファクト
limitations:
• Mixed lighting scenes naturally have varying color temperatures
• Auto ホワイトバランス correction normalizes results
• Narrow dynamic range reduces 検出 感度
• Colored objects can bias regional estimates
• Post-processing color grading masks 不整合
